summary: Well-structured test suite across three layers (unit, integration via act, workflow structure) with good coverage of core requirements: Cartesian product generation, exclude/include semantics, max-parallel/fail-fast configuration, size validation, JSON parsing, and end-to-end workflow execution through GitHub Actions. Tests include fixtures for basic, exclude, include, and oversize cases. Strengths: clear test organization, proper TDD structure, real act-based integration testing, rigorous workflow YAML validation with actionlint. Limitations: incomplete CLI input variation testing (stdin, ConfigPath, ConfigJson not explicitly tested); limited edge case rigor (no special character handling, stress testing, or complex include/exclude overlaps); output parsing via regex is somewhat brittle; error messages validated for presence but not exact format; no direct testing of stderr output quality. Would catch most regressions in core logic and workflow structure but might miss subtle behavioral bugs in edge cases and CLI argument handling.
